name: Bolt Torque Calculator
blurb: tightening torque and preload for a bolt size and material
intro: The torque that loads a metric coarse-thread bolt to a chosen share of its yield strength, and the preload it gives, by the VDI 2230 formulas with thread and head friction. Head bearing sizes are ISO 4017 / ISO 4762, holes ISO 273 medium.

inputs.label: Thread friction µG
inputs.help: 0.10-0.12 oiled zinc or black oxide; 0.14 dry zinc; 0.2+ dry stainless.

inputs.label: Yield utilisation
inputs.help: VDI 2230 uses 90 % of the yield strength.

inputs.label: Tightening factor αA
inputs.help: Max / min preload scatter: 1.6 torque wrench.

examples.title: M5 A2-70 cap screw with anti-seize

usage: Give the thread size (M2-M24 coarse), property class, head type, the thread and head friction coefficients and the yield utilisation in %. It returns the tightening torque in N m, the maximum and minimum preload in kN, the tensile stress in MPa and the equivalent nut factor, plus a table of torque against friction. Use it to put a torque value on a drawing or to check a joint's clamp force.
sources: VDI 2230 Part 1 (2015), section 5.5.1: permissible assembly preload and tightening torque
ISO 724 thread geometry; ISO 4017 / ISO 4762 bearing face diameters; ISO 273 clearance holes
Friction values: VDI 2230 table A5 ranges, rounded
